patch.title: Steel River Solar Phase 3: 500 MW EIA Plan, July 2030 Target
patch.description: EIA August 2026 lists Cypress Creek’s Steel River Solar Phase 3, plant 70399, with 500 MW SRSP3 solar and separate 250 MW SRSB3 battery, under construction at most 50% complete and planned for July 2030. Operator whole-program timing instead targets all three phases by 2029.

patch.longFormSummary:
• Native 500 MW is Phase 3 solar nameplate, excluding the separate battery and operator DC totals. July 2026 groundbreaking and $3.5B financing cover the first two phases, not a separate confirmed Phase 3 construction milestone or budget. Operator $4.5B-plus applies to the whole program; no phase solar-only budget verifies $550M.
  • Former MISO J1693 is a withdrawn 50 MW battery at Maynard 115 kV in Chippewa County, Minnesota, not this Arkansas phase. The shared EIA reporting point is not a Phase 3 surveyed centroid; operator schematic shows separate phase areas around Wilson/Marie. Existing phase/campus/battery pins are not additive independent projects.
  • Timeline: EIA July 2030 planned month; day 1 is a placeholder, not guaranteed COD. Operator all-phase 2029 target conflicts and remains explicit.
  • Cypress Creek’s identified Steel River construction-stage aerial showing vegetation and support posts. Broader program context; not independently labelled Phase 3 or an operating array. Credit: Cypress Creek Energy.
